{{Under construction}}
This page lists character appearances by chapter. Character names are linked directly, and chapter appearances are grouped by book within each character entry.

For brevity, contiguous numbered chapter appearances are compressed into linked ranges. A range such as {{tsr|31}}–{{tsr|33}} means the character appears in every numbered chapter from 31 through 33. Prologues, Ravens, and epilogues are kept as their own linked entries.

The main table lists characters with more than three chapter appearances. Characters with exactly three, two, or one appearances are summarized separately below the table. Within each appearance cell, different books are separated by semicolons and different chapters within the same book are separated by commas.Annour

Data source: [https://www.reddit.com/r/WoT/comments/ycjcpe/character_names_analysis/ Character Names Analysis] on Reddit.
